title: Shared definitions for capital-markets-asset-management-compliance skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (capital_markets_regulator_enum, registrant_type_enum, conflict_of_interest_disposition_enum) sit alongside the base definitions.

severity_enum.description: Standard four-step severity ladder. Best-execution exception severities and conflict-of-interest ratings use this scale.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by SEC / FINRA exam letters and audit findings where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Chief Investment Officer', 'Head of Trading Compliance', 'Head of Surveillance', 'General Counsel', 'Head of Regulatory Reporting'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common capital-markets gates: Rule 206(4)-7 / 38a-1 annual review sign-off, conflicts-committee adjudication, best-execution committee approval, marketing-rule pre-distribution review.

capital_markets_regulator_enum.description: Primary or relevant capital-markets regulator. Drives terminology, exam-cycle expectations, and applicable rule citations (Advisers Act vs. Investment Company Act vs. FINRA Conduct Rules).

registrant_type_enum.description: Registrant type that owns the obligation or artifact. Drives applicable rule set.

conflict_of_interest_disposition_enum.description: Disposition for an identified conflict of interest. SEC Marketing Rule and Advisers Act fiduciary expectations: disclosure alone is rarely sufficient; mitigation must be specific and documented.
